text: At a Louisville medical supply warehouse, foreman Frank shows new hire Freddy an army drum of Trioxin gas and [cracks it open by accident|origin|monsters people made], waking a cadaver in the meat locker. Smoke from its cremation drifts into a thunderstorm, and [toxic rain soaks the cemetery across the street|images|weather, sky and darkness] where Freddy's punk friends wait. [The dead climb from their graves|threat|the dead that rise] hungry for brains, and every severed part keeps moving, so the survivors barricade the mortuary and [call the number on the drum|wrong|the powerful abuse their power].
